name: CI Sentinel - GitHub Actions to Slack

parameters.content:
## CI Sentinel
1. Edit **Monitor settings**.
2. Select GitHub API credentials in **Fetch workflow runs**.
3. Select Slack API credentials in **Send Slack alert**.
4. Test once, then publish/activate.

Every 5 minutes. Failed attempts from the last 24 hours. Manual tests send real messages but do not persist deduplication. See README for delivery guarantees.
